name: Noir Film
tagline: Black-and-white film-frame world with sprocket holes, grain, corner marks, mono timecodes and serif-italic titles (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: pure black and white with grey tints only; no color accent

typography.style: ultra-tight bold sans with light serif italics and monospaced film metadata

best_for: Photography, film and storytelling decks where the content carries the color. Also a quiet, confident option for brand manifestos.
avoid_for: Cheerful, colorful or data-heavy business reporting.
